CommonErrorResponse.description: Client error. The request could not be completed because of a problem with the request itself - invalid or missing parameters (400), invalid or expired OAuth authentication (401), insufficient permission (403), or a resource that does not exist (404). Inspect `data.errorCode` and `data.errorMessage` to identify the cause, correct the request, and retry.

UnexpectedErrorResponse.description: Unexpected error. Something went wrong on the Zoho Analytics server while processing an otherwise valid request. This is not caused by the request payload and cannot be resolved by changing it. Retry after a short interval; if the error persists, contact Zoho Analytics support for assistance, quoting `data.errorCode` and the time of the request.
